profile_text.body:
Beamery is a London-based company, founded in 2012, that describes itself as an AI-powered workforce transformation platform aimed at enterprises. Its platform is designed to help organizations align talent strategy, plan workforce needs, and manage hiring, upskilling, and retention through a unified skills data layer. The company positions its approach as ethically grounded, with compliance and GDPR considerations reflected in UK hosting and what it describes as robust ethical AI models.

The core product suite includes a Workforce Intelligence Suite for scenario modeling, talent risk identification, and workforce planning across hiring, reskilling, and automation decisions. A notable component is Ray, described as an embedded agentic AI consultant that delivers context-aware recommendations to support talent decisions. Other platform elements include a Talent CRM, sourcing and matching tools, talent marketing, career sites and chatbot, campus and events tools, and skills and job design capabilities. The company names Flex and Salesforce as enterprise customers, with Flex using Beamery to convert unstructured job descriptions into a customized skills framework, and Salesforce using it to improve hire quality and enable real-time AI-powered talent recommendations.

The held facts confirm Beamery maintains a tracked presence on theworldofai.org, with its primary product categorized under HR and Talent AI and noted for its skills ontology and DEI analytics capabilities. No litigation or SEC filings are recorded against the company in the held data.
